feature.title: Knowledge before automation.
feature.subtitle: An idea I want to explore
feature.description: Automated systems need access to project knowledge, not just perception and task logic. I am interested in how construction information can become useful context for decisions, planning, and action.
feature.quote: What changes when a system understands the project, as well as the task?

about.title: Talha Shaharyar.
about.description:
I am a civil engineer based in Faisalabad, Pakistan, with experience across estimating, U.S. project delivery, and AI-powered product solutions.

My interests sit at the intersection of construction practice, BIM, project knowledge, and intelligent systems. I am building a career and research direction grounded in the real information and constraints that shape construction work.
